.NET is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2012 to 2014.

What it was for: [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (2) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [cs-benchmark](@/work/cs-benchmark.md): Simple C\# Benchmark; [Rocnikac4](@/work/rocnikac4.md); [reflex](@/work/reflex.md): .NET Reflection tools.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses .NET: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links .NET to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
